warnings.detail: The 5 Color Schemes variables (Text, Background, Foreground, Border, Accent) reference Primitives via aliases on the source. The Webflow MCP could not resolve cross-collection existing_variable_id on either create or update (returned 'variable not found' despite the target Primitive IDs being confirmed present). They were created with their resolved static values instead.
warnings.manual_fix: In the Giovanni Serrano Designer, open Variables > Color Schemes and set each variable's value to its matching Primitive (Text/Border/Accent -> Colors/Neutral Darkest, Background -> Colors/White, Foreground -> Colors/Neutral Lightest) to restore the live cascade. ~30 seconds.

warnings.detail: Source Color Schemes cssNames had no collection prefix (e.g. --color-scheme-1--text) while the target auto-generated --_color-schemes---color-scheme-1--text. Inconsequential for variables-only scope, but Relume classes that reference the unprefixed names would not match if styles are pasted later.
